title: Modernist Mid-Century Architecture Complex, 1956 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A deckled-edge black and white snapshot dated June 1956 showing a sleek mid-century modernist building complex with large glass window walls, a raised plaza, outdoor lighting fixtures, an adjacent stone tower, and young trees planted in an adjoining lower courtyard. The architectural style captures the post-WWII corporate and civic design boom in America.
